{{Quote|Welcome to Rorkee. I'm Lujei, your hostess and guide. We are glad to have you as our guests, and we hope you enjoy your stay.|Lujei, to the Heroes of Cularin|<ref name="Head in the Clouds">{{LivingForce|Clouds of Genarius: Head in the Clouds}}</ref>}}
'''Lujei''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]] during the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], working in the resort [[City/Legends|city]] [[Rorkee]]. In circa [[31 BBY/Legends|31 BBY]], Lujei greeted the [[Heroes of Cularin]], a group of freelance agents who had traveled to Rorkee, and she proceeded to give them a tour of the [[Sanads of Rorkee]], a luxury hotel that the agents were to stay at.
